id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_220.pack|cs_: "You're the bastard. No one in this world, not even my brother, ever helped me.
"But it's fine. Thanks to Lord Mordegon, I was revived. Now I command the power of gilding at will.
"Just as I turned those Vikings into pawns, now I'll use this power to work everyone in the world!
"So you did make the golden soldiers... Is that what you want now? Serving Mordegon, doing this...!
"Ha! Lecturing me now? What a fool, damn brother!
"...For five years I've thought about it. The meaning of my survival. What I must do.
"Mia, you becoming like this is entirely my fault. ...Then!
"Defeating you here is the atonement I'm charged with!!
"Damn brother and weakling Luminary acting like righteous heroes? You who never saved me, now!
"...Ugh, annoying. So annoying. Damn, damn, damn! Foolish brother and Luminary! I'll turn you all to gold!!"
